_note: The embed CORS decision table (/web/13 §32, S-06). web.embed.origins is a package's per-embed CORS allowlist; corsDecision(origins, requestOrigin) is the pure enforcement serve.ts applies to every /embed asset. Every row pins one (origins, Origin) -> expected response headers. This gates the DENY branch and the EXACT-MATCH branch that the G10 Playwright walk (an origins:['*'] package) never reaches. CORS is web-only embed-server infrastructure (no native twin — the SSR/bundling exemption of the tri-renderer law), so this corpus is web-local, not under OpenSource/Conformance.

cases.name: star allowlist echoes * for a foreign origin (the public embed — G10's ALLOW branch)
star allowlist echoes * even with NO Origin header (a same-origin/opaque fetch)
star wins even when listed alongside exact origins
EXACT match echoes that origin + vary:origin (the exact-match branch)
EXACT match of the second listed origin also echoes it + vary:origin
DENY: a foreign origin not on a non-star allowlist gets NO header
DENY: no Origin header against a non-star allowlist gets NO header (cannot echo a request origin)
DENY: the default empty allowlist ([] = embeds OFF for third parties) denies every origin
DENY: scheme mismatch is not a match (http vs the listed https)
DENY: a trailing slash / path makes it a different origin string (exact string match only)
DENY: a subdomain is not the registered origin (no wildcard subdomain matching)
DENY: a differing port is a different origin
